dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Distinct 'O' ring on mid-flank with high-contrast light perimeter and dark interior; series of overlapping 'C' and 'O' shapes forming a reticulated chain along the anterior-lateral flank; large irregular undulating light loops on the dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid blobs; high-intensity pixel concentration observed as a dense cluster of white speckles on the muzzle/facial region and a single localized bright spot on the mid-dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent lateral rings form a right-leaning scalene triangle; a broader geometric relationship is visible between the mid-flank annulus and the two largest dorsal loop junctions forming an obtuse triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex vermiculated pattern where light-colored lines form interlocking, maze-like boundaries across the mid-section, creating a puzzle-piece appearance.
